properties.name: idempotency.enabled
properties.description: Master switch for the starter. Set to false to disable @Idempotent entirely without removing the dependency.

properties.name: idempotency.store
properties.description: Which IdempotencyStore backs replay. AUTO picks Redis when spring-boot-starter-data-redis is present, otherwise fails startup unless MEMORY or JDBC is set explicitly.

properties.name: idempotency.default-ttl
properties.description: How long a claimed key (and its completed record) is retained when @Idempotent#ttl() is not set.

properties.name: idempotency.header-name
properties.description: Request header carrying the client-supplied idempotency key, when @Idempotent#keyHeader() is not set.

properties.name: idempotency.require-key
properties.description: Reject requests with no idempotency key (400) instead of passing them through unprotected.

properties.name: idempotency.on-conflict
properties.description: What to do when a duplicate request arrives while the first is still IN_PROGRESS.

properties.name: idempotency.wait-timeout
properties.description: Maximum time a WAIT-policy duplicate polls for the in-flight request to complete before returning 409.

properties.name: idempotency.scope
properties.description: Default namespace for storage keys, when @Idempotent#scope() is DEFAULT. Defaults to GLOBAL, which needs no Spring Security. USER and TENANT require an authenticated principal (Spring Security).

properties.name: idempotency.tenant-claim
properties.description: JWT claim read by the built-in TENANT scope resolver.

properties.name: idempotency.on-missing-principal
properties.description: What to do when a USER/TENANT-scoped request has no resolvable authenticated principal. GLOBAL falls back to the global namespace; SKIP executes unprotected; REJECT returns 400.

properties.name: idempotency.on-store-failure
properties.description: PROCEED executes the handler unprotected (with a WARN log) when the store is unreachable; FAIL returns 503.

properties.name: idempotency.problem-details
properties.description: Register the built-in RFC 9457 ProblemDetail exception advice for the library's own exceptions.

properties.name: idempotency.max-payload-size
properties.description: Responses larger than this are executed normally but not cached for replay; a WARN is logged instead.

properties.name: idempotency.release-on
properties.description: Which handler outcomes release the claimed key (allowing a clean retry) instead of completing it for replay.

properties.name: idempotency.redis.key-prefix
properties.description: Prefix applied to every Redis key the store writes.

properties.name: idempotency.jdbc.table-name
properties.description: Name of the table created by db/idempotency/postgres.sql.

properties.name: idempotency.jdbc.sweeper-enabled
properties.description: Run a background task that deletes expired rows. Off by default: the atomic claim already reclaims expired rows on the hot path, so this only matters for disk usage on keys nobody ever retries.

properties.name: idempotency.jdbc.sweeper-interval
properties.description: How often the sweeper runs, when enabled.

properties.name: idempotency.jdbc.join-transaction
properties.description: Run the handler and the completion write in one shared transaction so they commit or roll back together (exactly-once), instead of committing separately (at-least-once). Off by default: it pulls handlers with no @Transactional of their own into a transaction, and a handler's own @Transactional(timeout) stops applying once it joins.

properties.name: idempotency.metrics.enabled
properties.description: Publish idempotency counters to Micrometer when a MeterRegistry is present. All outcomes land on one counter, idempotency.requests, tagged by outcome (executed, replayed, released, conflict, ...). Set false to keep the no-op implementation even in an application that has a registry.

values.description: Redis if present on the classpath, otherwise fail startup unless overridden.
